title: A11yLTLNav: Automatic Detection of Accessibility Navigation Failures
abstract: arXiv:2609.17959v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: For blind and low-vision (BLV) screen-reader users, a website that appears accessible in a static snapshot can become difficult or impossible to navigate once interaction begins. Yet, most automated accessibility checkers miss failures involving focus, interface state, and accessible feedback across interactions. We present A11yLTLNav, a property-based approach for automatically detecting accessibility navigation failures. Through a structured review of prior research, we organize accessibility navigation failures into a failure taxonomy and formalize a browser-observable subset as executable Linear Temporal Logic properties over action-state traces. A11yLTLNav combines random keyboard exploration with runtime property monitoring to detect these failures during interactions. translated_title: A11yLTLNav：无障碍导航失败的自动检测
translated_abstract: 对于盲人和低视力（BLV）屏幕阅读器用户来说，一个在静态快照中看起来无障碍的网站，一旦开始交互就可能变得难以甚至无法导航。然而，大多数自动化无障碍检查工具会遗漏涉及焦点、界面状态和跨交互无障碍反馈的失败情况。我们提出了A11yLTLNav，一种基于属性的自动检测无障碍导航失败的方法。通过对先前研究的结构化综述，我们将无障碍导航失败组织成一个失败分类法，并将其中浏览器可观察的子集形式化为基于动作-状态轨迹的可执行线性时序逻辑属性。A11yLTLNav结合随机键盘探索与运行时属性监控，在交互过程中检测这些失败。我们在基于真实网站和任务生成的31个网站上评估了A11yLTLNav，它报告了309个无障碍失败，其中274个得到确认，达到了（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: A11yLTLNav通过将无障碍导航失败形式化为可执行的线性时序逻辑属性，并结合随机键盘探索与运行时属性监控，能够在交互过程中自动检测网站的无障碍导航失败，在31个网站的评估中确认了274个失败。
en_tdlr: A11yLTLNav formalizes accessibility navigation failures as executable Linear Temporal Logic properties and combines random keyboard exploration with runtime property monitoring to automatically detect navigation failures during interactions, confirming 274 failures in evaluations on 31 websites.
